name: AMP-HEL 20 kW laser (LOCUST on ISV)
description: Army RCCTO prototype: 20 kW-class LOCUST laser on an Infantry Squad Vehicle for maneuver-force C-UAS. Two ISV sets delivered Aug 2025; two JLTV sets with radar and C2 followed. Single-target hard kill by dwell. The engagement range is NOT published: this ring is a planning value, not a performance claim. Heavily degraded by fog, rain and dust.

maxRangeM.note: Inventory records 5000 m; the seed value is kept

engageTimeS.condition: dwell time to effect — NO PUBLIC VALUE. Dwell to effect varies with range, aspect and airframe. Representative value = app DE baseline (DEFAULT_SALVO_COOLDOWN_S.de = 15 s) and the existing library DE tier.

outputPowerKw.condition: 20 kW-class LOCUST laser weapon system on the Infantry Squad Vehicle, first AMP-HEL increment
outputPowerKw.source: AeroVironment press release, 3 September 2025, quoted from the search index

beamQualityM2.note: Planning factor: no high-energy laser programme publishes a beam quality. Open optics references put high-power multimode and combined-fibre beams at M squared of about 1.5 to 3; 2.0 is the planning value for every laser in the library.

jitterUrad.note: Planning factor: no high-energy laser programme publishes a pointing jitter. The Airborne Laser Laboratory of the 1980s held about 25 urad and modern beam control is better, so 10 urad at 1 sigma is the planning value for every laser in the library.

apertureM.note: Planning factor: no high-energy laser programme publishes a beam director aperture. Open beam-director literature describes 30 to 50 cm apertures for weapon-class systems; 0.30 m is the planning value for every laser in the library.

dwellToEffectS.note: No dwell time to defeat a drone is published for this system. The programme has released engagement results but no engagement timeline; not established by the public record.
